tuition.notes: Bursar page 'Tuition and Fees 2026-27 College'; 'These direct costs are billed quarterly'. Per quarter, not multiplied to a year (three quarters in the usual academic year). Quarterly fees on the same page: College Student Services Fee 559, U-Pass 106, College Class Fee 240; health insurance (USHIP) separate. The bursar index lists 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 only; no 2027-28 schedule is published, so this is the previous academic year for a fall 2027 entry (expected to be kept as stale). The round-1 access failure (HTTP 403 on bursar.uchicago.edu) no longer occurs: the page answered 200 to the production user agent on 2026-10-19.
